info.text:
The typical US stock lost money: a median lifetime return of -6.9% from 1926 to 2025.
Yet $1 in the whole US market grew to $15,401 over the same century.
Just 46 companies created half of the $91 trillion in stock market wealth.
At the end of 2000, 62% of Enron's 401(k) plan was Enron stock. Shares fell from $90.75 to 26 cents by Nov 2001.
Sources: Bessembinder, One Hundred Years in the U.S. Stock Markets (2026); CNBC; Congressional Research Service.
News and education, not financial advice.
